rules.name: xoga750-uat-01-discovery
rules.sql: SELECT d.business_application_name, d.document_name, d.storage_type, d.size_bytes, length(d.document) AS db_bytes, md5(d.document) AS db_md5, d.updated_timestamp FROM opera.oga_document_repository d WHERE d.tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND (upper(d.business_application_name) IN ('WEB XTR','GPC TRADE','NEOVEST') OR d.document_name ILIKE '%XTRFills%' OR d.document_name ILIKE '%MMVT%' OR d.document_name ILIKE '%GPC%') ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT s.sequence_criteria ->> 'businessUnit' AS business_unit, s.last_sequence_id, s.start_value, s.end_value, s.sequence_type, s.parent_uuid, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.oga_configservice_transactionidformatmaster f WHERE f.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND f.uuid::text = s.parent_uuid AND f.transaction_type = 'tradeId') AS parent_is_tradeid_format FROM opera.oga_transaction_id_sequence_criteria s WHERE s.tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) AS gpc_trade_rows, max(CAST(substring(trade_id from '([0-9]+)$') AS bigint)) AS max_suffix, min(trade_id) AS min_trade_id, max(trade_id) AS max_trade_id FROM opera.deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND business_unit = 'GPC' AND trade_id ~ '[0-9]+$'
SELECT bu_name, trade_name FROM opera.web_xtr_handle_portfolio_traderwise_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' ORDER BY 1, 2
